  "relation": "REFINED",
  "consensus_summary": "Primary meaning of field is the world (explicitly per Jesus in Matt 13:38), the sphere of humanity where the kingdom/gospel is sown, good and evil coexist until harvest; closely linked secondary senses include the mission/harvest field of souls, the church as God's cultivated field, and (by frequent conflation) human hearts as soils.",
  "book_summary": "The world (Jesus' own decoding), sown with the seed of the word and reaped at the harvest; its unreaped edge is where the poor and stranger glean, and its hidden treasure is bought whole to be mined.",
  "consensus_core_identification": "the world",
  "book_core_identification": "the world",
  "core_relation": "EQUIVALENT",
  "extension_relation": "BOOK_SUPERSET",
  "boundary_disagreement": "Book folds in the unreaped corners/gleanings for the poor and stranger (Lev 19) plus the hidden-treasure purchase as constitutive features of the world-field; consensus either omits these or treats them as separate/minor alternatives rather than integral to the primary identification.",
  "material_contradiction": "none",
  "rationale": "Minimum cores are identical (world via Matt 13:38). Extra book detail is not mere wording: it materially enlarges the extension by making gleaning law and treasure-in-field definitional of the same referent, producing a refined boundary without replacing the central identification. Thus REFINED with BOOK_SUPERSET extension rather than MATCH or DIVERGENT.",
  "citation_support": "PARTIAL",
  "strongest_objection": "Levitical gleaning commands are agricultural/social legislation, not symbolic decoding of 'field = world'; integrating them (and the treasure) may over-harmonize texts the consensus keeps distinct or secondary.",
  "confidence": "high"
}
